_note: Hand-curated interaction rules that DDInter lacks: its bulk files do not hold several cardiovascular pairs, and Indian-only drugs are missing. Each rule expands to every a x b pair. Where DDInter also lists a pair, the more severe level is used. Severity and wording are drafts for the pharmacist to confirm.

rules.note: dual blockade of the renin-angiotensin system raises the risk of low blood pressure, high potassium and kidney injury
rules.source: ONTARGET (N Engl J Med 2008;358:1547); product labelling. Added by the developer, not yet checked by a pharmacist
